title: The Endless Hymn
author: Quentin Pemberton
blurb: Ulyana Brightwater, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
